productionContract.constructor: ExecutionController(runtime_root, admission_adapter=callable, provider=object, stage_runner=callable, durability_ops=DurabilityOps|None, boundary_hook=callable|None)
productionContract.method: execute(slot_key=str, issue_date=str, authority=mapping, payload=mapping, observed_at=datetime) -> RECONCILE_EXECUTION_RESULT_V1

authoritySchema.binding: authoritySha256 is canonical hash of the other exact fields and all slot/generation/owner/fence values equal the current S1 active slot

productionContract.admissionAdapter: callable(request) returns exact HIGH_COST_ADMISSION_DECISION_V1 with status GRANTED|DENIED|UNAVAILABLE and the same authority/idempotency binding

provider.dispatch: dispatch(request) returns CONFIRMED receipt or raises ExternalResultUnknown after an unknown response
provider.query: query(idempotency_key) returns PRESENT with receipt, ABSENT, AMBIGUOUS, or UNAVAILABLE

productionContract.stageRunner: callable(stage_id, input_payload) for harvest and finalize returns mapping with lowercase 64-hex outputHash or raises; model is provider-owned

requiredNodes.oracle: GRANTED reserves once; DENIED/UNAVAILABLE/malformed are distinct typed outcomes with provider dispatch/query count zero
fault immediately before/after INTENT_DURABLE, DISPATCHED, CONFIRMED, and COMMITTED; resume converges with one idempotency key and no duplicate confirmed effect

lost response persists DISPATCHED/RESULT_UNKNOWN; next call queries first, PRESENT confirms without resend, AMBIGUOUS/UNAVAILABLE never resend, ABSENT may resend only the same key within maxDispatchAttempts
after each durable checkpoint, resume skips every completed harvest/model stage and continues only at the next deterministic stage
tampered checkpoint is CHECKPOINT_CORRUPT; a missing checkpoint referenced by durable stage state is CHECKPOINT_MISSING; both have zero new provider effect
harvest/model/finalize child failures are CHILD_FAILED with stage identity; retry does not replay earlier completed stages or consume a second admission
for the fault corpus, persisted transitions are an exact prefix of the canonical state list, never regress/skip, and terminal success ends COMMITTED
fsync/parent-flush failure before INTENT_DURABLE yields DURABILITY_FAILED and dispatch zero; response loss is recovered only by provider query
after an external receipt but before COMMITTED, a changed S1 generation/owner/fence yields STALE_FENCE, never commits the checkpoint, and retry by stale authority has zero dispatch
